input.description: Same measures as Westerly Shopper Metrics, keyed on the unified individual Id so the Data 360 profile page (cdpProfileInsights) can list it
input.expression: SELECT UnifiedssotIndividualWstr__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS unified_individual_id__c, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), ssot__SalesOrder__dlm.ssot__OrderStartDate__c) <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_last_30_days__c, COUNT(ssot__SalesOrder__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS total_orders__c, AVG(ssot__SalesOrder__dlm.ssot__GrandTotalAmount__c) AS avg_cart_value__c, CASE WHEN COUNT(ssot__SalesOrder__dlm.ssot__Id__c) > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_top_shopper__c FROM ssot__SalesOrder__dlm INNER JOIN UnifiedLinkssotIndividualWstr__dlm ON ssot__SalesOrder__dlm.ssot__SoldToCustomerId__c = UnifiedLinkssotIndividualWstr__dlm.SourceRecordId__c INNER JOIN UnifiedssotIndividualWstr__dlm ON UnifiedLinkssotIndividualWstr__dlm.UnifiedRecordId__c = UnifiedssotIndividualWstr__dlm.ssot__Id__c GROUP BY UnifiedssotIndividualWstr__dlm.ssot__Id__c
